sql:
SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(*) AS lojas
FROM brands b
GROUP BY b.name
SELECT SUM(total) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND sold_at < DATE '2026-01-01'

SELECT s.name AS loja, COUNT(e.id) AS numero_de_funcionarios
FROM stores s
JOIN employees e ON s.id = e.store_id
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY numero_de_funcionarios DESC

SELECT p.payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao, COUNT(*) AS taloes
FROM sales s
JOIN payments p ON s.payment_method = p.method
WHERE s.sold_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY faturacao DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN stores st ON st.id = sl.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY quantidade DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(total) FROM sales WHERE store_id IN (SELECT id FROM stores WHERE name LIKE '%Café Aroma%')

SELECT b.name AS marca, pm.name AS produto, pm.price AS preco,
       pm.unit_cost AS custo, pm.margin_pct AS margem_pct
FROM product_margins pm
JOIN brands b ON b.id = pm.brand_id
ORDER BY pm.margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT pl.purchase_id, pl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM purchase_lines pl JOIN products p ON p.id = pl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'acompanhamento'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pl.purchase_id, pl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM purchase_lines pl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = pl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'acompanhamento'
)
SELECT su.name AS fornecedor, w.name AS armazem, p.ordered_at AS data_encomenda,
       ROUND(SUM(pl.quantity * pl.unit_cost), 2) AS valor
FROM purchases p JOIN suppliers su ON su.id = p.supplier_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id
JOIN purchase_lines pl ON pl.purchase_id = p.id
WHERE p.status = 'encomendada'
GROUP BY p.id, su.name, w.name, p.ordered_at ORDER BY p.ordered_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transfers WHERE transfer_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND transfer_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

SELECT i.name AS ingrediente, i.unit_cost AS custo_unitario
FROM ingredients i
ORDER BY i.unit_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

SELECT st.name AS loja, ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
  AND st.name LIKE 'Maia%'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN s.payment_method LIKE '%MB Way%' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN s.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END) AS diferenca_faturacao FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND s.sold_at <= DATE '2026-10-31'

SELECT m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS unidades_vendidas
FROM sale_lines sl
JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id
WHERE sl.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND sl.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY m.name
ORDER BY unidades_vendidas DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'pastelaria'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'pastelaria'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS pastelarias
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY pastelarias DESC
SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM stock WHERE store_id IS NULL

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT w.name AS armazém, i.name AS produto, SUM(il.quantity) AS quantidade
  FROM warehouses w
  JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id
  JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = s.ingredient_id
  GROUP BY w.name, i.name
)
SELECT armazém, produto, quantidade
FROM stock
ORDER BY armazém, quantidade DESC

WITH transfers_by_brand AS (
  SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS transfers
  FROM stores s
  JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id
  JOIN transfers t ON t.store_id = s.id
  WHERE t.transfer_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.transfer_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
  GROUP BY b.name
)
SELECT brand, transfers
FROM transfers_by_brand
ORDER BY transfers DESC

WITH encomendas AS (
  SELECT p.supplier_id, SUM(pl.quantity * pl.unit_cost) AS total_encomendas
  FROM purchases p
  JOIN purchase_lines pl ON p.id = pl.purchase_id
  WHERE p.status = 'recebida'
  GROUP BY p.supplier_id
),
total_recebido AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_encomendas) AS total_recebido
  FROM encomendas
)
SELECT total_recebido AS valor_total FROM total_recebido

SELECT p.payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS talao_medio, COUNT(*) AS taloes
FROM sales s
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY talao_medio DESC

SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(e.id) AS funcionários
FROM brands b
JOIN employees e ON b.id = e.brand_id
GROUP BY b.name

SELECT AVG(e.hourly_rate) AS custo_horario_medio
FROM employees e
WHERE e.role = 'barista'

SELECT SUM(s.total) FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab Maia' AND s.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' GROUP BY MONTH(s.sold_at) ORDER BY MONTH(s.sold_at) ASC

WITH horarios AS (
  SELECT e.full_name AS nome, e.start_time AS horario
  FROM employees e
  WHERE e.role = 'cafe_aroma_porto'
),
taloes AS (
  SELECT h.nome AS nome, COUNT(*) AS talao
  FROM horarios h
  GROUP BY h.nome
  ORDER BY talao DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT nome AS nome_cafe, horario AS horario_maximo FROM taloes

SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN s.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN s.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) AS crescimento_percentual FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND((SUM(s.total) / SUM(s.total)) * 100, 2) AS percentagem_receita
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY percentagem_receita DESC

SELECT b.name AS marca, st.name AS loja, SUM(s.total) AS faturacao
FROM sales s
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY b.name, st.name
ORDER BY faturacao DESC
LIMIT 2

SELECT SUM(T1.quantity * (T1.unit_price - T2.unit_cost)) AS total_margem
FROM sale_lines AS T1
JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.sale_id IN (
    SELECT id FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
)

SELECT b.name AS marca, SUM(pm.unit_margin + mm.unit_margin) AS total_margin_euros
FROM brands b
JOIN menu_margins mm ON mm.brand_id = b.id
JOIN product_margins pm ON pm.brand_id = b.id
WHERE mm.marginal_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY b.name
ORDER BY total_margin_euros DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_recommendations WHERE classification = 'cão'
SELECT p.name FROM price_recommendations p WHERE p.classification = 'estrela'

SELECT T1.store_id, T1.name, CAST((SUM(T2.total) - SUM(T1.total)) / SUM(T1.total) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) * 100 AS crescimento_percentual
FROM sales AS T1
JOIN stores AS T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.sold_at BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'
GROUP BY T1.store_id, T1.name
ORDER BY crescimento_percentual DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS marca, SUM(sh.start_time::date - sh.end_time::date) * e.hourly_rate AS custo_total
FROM shifts sh
JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY custo_total DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.name AS produto, SUM(sl.quantity) AS unidade_vendida
FROM sale_lines sl
JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
WHERE sl.sale_id NOT IN (
    SELECT id FROM menu_items
)
AND sl.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
AND sl.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY unidade_vendida DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT e.nif FROM employees e WHERE e.full_name LIKE '%Maia%' AND e.role LIKE 'Gerente' AND e.store_id IS NULL
SELECT T1.city AS cidade FROM stores AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.store_id WHERE T2.role = 'gerente' AND T1.name LIKE '%Café Aroma%'
DELETE FROM sales WHERE YEAR(sold_at) = 2025
NO_SQL

SELECT teams.name FROM teams WHERE teams.id IN (SELECT tournament_teams.team_id FROM tournament_teams JOIN tournaments ON tournament_teams.tournament_id = tournaments.id WHERE tournaments.year = 2022 AND tournaments.stage = 'final') ORDER BY teams.world_cup_wins DESC LIMIT 1
